chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:

There is no servant who gives preference over hajj to a need from among the needs of the world, except that he will look at those who shaved their heads having already returned before that need is fulfilled for him.

key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْمُحَلِّقِينَ: the pilgrims who have shaved their heads after completing the rites
key_terms.انْصَرَفُوا: they departed and returned from hajj

ai.seo_question: What happens when someone prioritizes worldly needs over hajj?
ai.summary: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام teaches that giving worldly concerns priority over hajj brings regret and loss. The hadith warns that a person may delay this act of worship for worldly aims, only to see the hajj season pass and the pilgrims return before his worldly need is even fulfilled.
